title: Short title, and Commencement
text: These rules may be called the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. They come into force on 1 April 2011.

title: Definitions
text: This rule defines terms used in the rules, including dealer, lot, manufacturer, maximum permissible error, net quantity, packer, principal display panel, quantity, retail dealer, package, retail sale, retail sale price, section, schedule, standard package, wholesale dealer and wholesale package.

title: Applicability of the Chapter
text: This rule specifies the applicability of the provisions of the chapter and the packages or commodities to which the provisions apply or do not apply.

title: Pre-packing or import for sale
text: This rule deals with requirements relating to pre-packing or importing commodities for sale, distribution or delivery.

title: Specific commodities to be packed and sold in recommended standard
text: packages This rule deals with specified commodities that are required to be packed and sold in recommended standard quantities/packages.

title: Declarations to be made on every package
text: Every package is required to bear the prescribed declarations. These include applicable declarations relating to the manufacturer/packer/importer, commodity, net quantity, retail sale price and consumer-related information, subject to the specific requirements and exemptions in the rules.

title: Principal display panel — its area, size and letter etc.
text: This rule specifies requirements concerning the principal display panel, including its area, size and the manner in which prescribed declarations are displayed.

title: Declaration where to appear
text: This rule specifies where the required declarations are to appear on the package.

title: Manner in which declaration shall be made
text: This rule specifies the manner in which declarations must be made, including requirements concerning visibility, legibility and the prescribed presentation of declarations.

title: Declaration of name and address of the manufacturer, etc.
text: This rule specifies requirements for declaring the name and address of the manufacturer, packer and/or importer, as applicable.

title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity
text: This rule contains general requirements for declaring the quantity of the commodity in the package.

title: Manner in which declaration of quantity shall be made
text: This rule specifies the manner and form in which the quantity declaration is to be made.

title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
text: This rule specifies the units in which declarations of weight, measure or number are to be expressed.

title: Declarations with regard to dimensions of certain commodities
text: This rule contains requirements for declarations concerning dimensions of specified commodities.

title: Declaration with regard to dimensions and weight to be made on
text: packages This rule specifies declarations concerning dimensions and weight for applicable packages.

title: Declarations to be made with regard to the number of usable units
text: This rule deals with declarations concerning the number of usable units where applicable.

title: Declarations with regard to the dimensions of container type packages
text: This rule specifies declaration requirements concerning dimensions for container-type packages.

title: Provisions relating to wholesale dealer and retail dealers
text: This rule specifies obligations and restrictions applicable to wholesale dealers and retail dealers in relation to packaged commodities.

title: Inspection of quantity and error in packages at the premises of the
text: manufacturer/packer/importer This rule deals with inspection of packages and verification of quantity and permissible error at the relevant premises.

title: Action to be taken on completion of inspection of packages
text: This rule specifies action to be taken after inspection of packages.

title: Inspection of quantity and error in packages at the premises of wholesale
text: dealer This rule deals with inspection and verification of quantity and error in packages at wholesale dealer premises.

title: Establishment of maximum permissible error on package
text: This rule deals with the establishment/application of maximum permissible error for packages.

title: Deceptive packages to be repacked or in default to be seized
text: This rule deals with packages considered deceptive and provides for repacking or seizure in the circumstances specified by the rules.

title: Wholesale package
text: This rule specifies declarations and other requirements applicable to wholesale packages.

title: Restrictions on sale of export packages in India
text: This rule places restrictions on the sale of export packages in India, subject to the conditions specified in the rules.

title: Exemption in respect of certain packages
text: This rule provides exemptions for specified packages/categories, subject to the conditions stated in the rules.

title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
text: This rule contains requirements relating to registration of manufacturers, packers and importers.

title: Registration of shorter address permissible
text: This rule provides for circumstances in which a shorter address may be used for registration/declaration, subject to the prescribed requirements.

title: Registration of manufacturers and packers, etc.
text: This rule contains further provisions concerning registration of manufacturers, packers and related persons.

title: Compilation of lists of manufacturers or packers and their circulation
text: This rule deals with compilation and circulation of lists of manufacturers or packers.

title: Prohibition of advertisements
text: This rule contains requirements/restrictions relating to advertisements and declarations concerning packaged commodities.

title: Penalty for contravention of Rules
text: This rule deals with consequences/penalties for contravention of the rules.

title: Power to relax
text: This rule provides the Central Government with power to relax specified requirements in the circumstances and manner provided by the rules.

title: Repeal and savings
text: This rule deals with repeal and savings, including the treatment of the earlier Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules and matters saved by the new rules.
